blocks.text: There is no Gateway C0/C3 empirical outcome in this artifact. The PSA qualification slice stopped in C0 after 37 calls and `$0.093275` actual cost: Gateway resolved the requested frozen 0731 slug to unversioned Flash and omitted actual provider/fallback metadata. Its raw controlled events and aborted manifest are failed transport evidence, not support for any hypothesis; C3 and the scorer did not run. Archived OpenRouter/Novita and unversioned-Flash smoke records remain historical operational evidence only.

Result entries must name the frozen configuration, task/source hash, fixed `deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` slug, Gateway adapter version, requested/resolved model, actual provider, Gateway `usage.cost`, fallback status/metadata, token/latency values, run records, scorer output, and any applicable Proofpress capsule verification record. The first PSA C0/C3 five-checkpoint serial-SAS attempt, `gateway-0731-harvey-psa-c0-c3-qualification-v1`, failed this audit before C3/scoring and cannot be repaired by treating unknown routing metadata as no fallback. Missing telemetry is a qualification failure, not a zero-cost observation. ARA indexes research meaning and evidence pointers; Proofpress supplies C3 artifact-native admitted lineage and independent verification, never a benchmark agent's implicit memory or raw session transcript.
